# Saarthi Studio

Saarthi Studio is a creative web design and digital branding studio focused on premium landing pages, brand identity, and conversion-focused websites.

## What this site contains

- Home page with services, showcases, testimonials, FAQ, and contact CTA
- A contact form that submits through SvelteKit server actions
- A thank-you page for successful submissions

## Key pages

- https://www.saarthistudio.com/

## Tech stack

- SvelteKit
- Svelte 5
- Tailwind CSS
- GSAP
- Lenis
- MongoDB via Mongoose

## Notes for crawlers

- This site is intended to be indexed
- Main content is on the homepage
- Contact submissions are handled server-side
